text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro position stated in the opening","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It states its position on driverless cars early and keeps that position visible throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"paragraphs beginning with 'First,' 'Next,' 'Also,' and 'So,'","quality":"organization","description":"It uses a more orderly paragraph structure that makes the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"multiple benefits listed: fuel, money, safety, time, lives","quality":"breadth of support","description":"It develops the claim with several distinct reasons instead of relying on just one or two points."},{"evidence":"mentions alert systems, sensors, and human takeover needs","quality":"use of source details","description":"It draws on more specific information from the article to support its claims."},{"evidence":"addresses concerns about accidents and blame before rebutting them","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges opposition and answers it rather than only repeating its own side."},{"evidence":"closing restates safety and future improvement","quality":"conclusion strength","description":"It ends by summarizing the main claim and giving the argument a more complete finish."}]}
